_note: Anchors the automatic remap gets wrong, each read verse by verse and corrected by hand.
Every entry names the source reference in en.json and where it belongs in that edition, and
quotes what settles it. They were found by cross-check-headings.py, which compares two
editions of the same tradition against each other: nothing else here had noticed any of them.
The remap refuses to apply an override whose target verse does not exist, so a dataset change
that invalidates one of these fails loudly instead of shipping a stale correction.

15: 13:24 is the tribe of Gad; 13:15 is 'a possession to the children of Ruben'

43: 9:43 is 'Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit'; 9:44 is 'all were astonished at the greatness of God'

18: there is no 1:18 here; 2:1 is 'behold four horns' and 2:5 is the man with the measuring line

8: 6:8 is 'Charge Aaron and his sons'; 6:7 is 'And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying'

6: 18:6 is 'departing from Jerusalem, he made war against the Persians'; 18:7 is 'the righteous mother'
